title: ChatSirLaxFirebaseBlueprint
description: Firestore blueprint schema for Chat Sir Lax user data, community impact, study notes, and meal donations

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with study statistics, badges, and learning level

ChatMessageDoc.title: ChatMessageDoc
ChatMessageDoc.description: A chat interaction between the student and Sir Lax

StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: Saved lesson note or project outline eligible for export to Google Workspace

MealDonation.title: MealDonation
MealDonation.description: Logged community meal contribution through direct sponsor or ad view

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and learning progress

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: User conversation history with Sir Lax

/users/{userId}/study_notes/{noteId}.description: User saved study notes and lesson summaries

/meal_donations/{donationId}.description: Public ledger of sponsored meals and ad-sponsored student nourishment
